summary.abstract_hr: Kevin Monette iz Encounter Ministries u Hrvatskoj drži predavanje o ozdravljenju u braku, a prevoditelj ga simultano prevodi na hrvatski. Kroz odlomak iz Prve poslanice Korinćanima 13 o osobinama ljubavi, koji je podijelio u šest skupina, iznosi osobno svjedočanstvo o krizi u braku sa suprugom Rose. Ta je kriza nakon šest godina braka dovela do razmatranja razvoda, odnosno poništenja braka. Opisuje kako su mu pomogli odustajanje od vođenja službe, svakodnevna prisutnost uz suprugu bez ometanja, odricanje od privrženosti stvarima i molitva za raskidanje duševnih veza. Na katoličkoj konferenciji za ozdravljenje njegova je supruga otkrila i oprostila zlostavljanje iz djetinjstva. Predavanje završava pozivom prisutnima da obnove bračne zavjete.
key_points: Kevin je u brak ušao s brojnim očekivanjima koja se nisu ispunila. Na temelju Izreka 13,12 ističe da neispunjena nada čini srce bolesnim, a da bez Boga supružnici izvlače najgore jedno iz drugoga.
Smatra da đavao mrzi brak i nastoji razdvojiti supružnike. Zato poručuje onima u službi da borbu protiv kraljevstva tame počnu u vlastitom braku, jer je zvanje 'najglasnija poruka evanđelja'.

Nakon što mu je supruga rekla da voli službu više od nje, a duhovnik mu savjetovao da je napusti, dao je ostavku. Svaku je večer sjedao na kauč bez mobitela i televizora te čekao suprugu, nakon čega je u njihovom odnosu uslijedila obnova.

Prepoznao je pohlepu kao navezanost na sigurnost i riješio se brojnih filmova i svjetovne glazbe koji su negativno utjecali na suprugu. Nakon toga im je postalo lakše moliti, a u godinu dana zajedno su pročitali više od 40 knjiga o ozdravljenju i oslobođenju.

U vrhuncu krize supruga je razmišljala o poništenju braka. Kevin je s njom molio devetnicu Gospi koja razvezuje čvorove te izmolio molitvu za raskidanje duševnih veza, nakon čega mu se supruga ispričala i rekla da joj je Bog razotkrio laž.

Na konferenciji dr. Boba Schutza supruga je prema njegovu svjedočanstvu ozdravila od celijakije. Prisjetila se i seksualnog zlostavljanja iz treće godine života te je oprostila zlostavljaču iz obitelji.
Kevin naglašava da otkrivanje rane ne znači i njezino ozdravljenje. Njihov je put uključivao savjetovanje te brojne molitve oslobođenja, a na kraju je pozvao prisutne da obnove bračne zavjete.
key_points_en: Kevin entered marriage with numerous expectations that were not fulfilled. Based on Proverbs 13:12, he points out that hope deferred makes the heart sick, and that without God spouses bring out the worst in each other.

He believes that the devil hates marriage and seeks to separate spouses. Therefore, he tells those in ministry to begin the battle against the kingdom of darkness in their own marriage, because vocation is 'the loudest message of the gospel'.

After his wife told him that he loved ministry more than her, and his spiritual director advised him to leave it, he resigned. Every evening he sat on the couch without a mobile phone and television and waited for his wife, after which renewal followed in their relationship.

He recognized greed as an attachment to security and got rid of numerous movies and secular music that negatively affected his wife. After that, it became easier for them to pray, and in one year together they read more than 40 books on healing and deliverance.

At the height of the crisis, his wife was considering an annulment of marriage. Kevin prayed the novena to Our Lady, Undoer of Knots with her and prayed a prayer for breaking soul ties, after which his wife apologized to him and said that God had revealed a lie to her.

At a conference of Dr. Bob Schutz, according to his testimony, his wife was healed of celiac disease. She also recalled sexual abuse from her third year of life and forgave the abuser from the family.

Kevin emphasizes that uncovering a wound does not mean its healing. Their journey included counseling and numerous prayers of deliverance, and at the end he invited those present to renew their marital vows.
summary.abstract_en: Kevin Monette from Encounter Ministries in Croatia gives a lecture on healing in marriage, and a translator translates him simultaneously into Croatian. Through a passage from the First Epistle to the Corinthians 13 on the characteristics of love, which he divided into six groups, he presents a personal testimony about a crisis in his marriage with his wife Rose. That crisis after six years of marriage led to the consideration of divorce, that is, the annulment of marriage. He describes how giving up leading ministry, daily presence alongside his wife without distractions, renouncing attachment to things, and prayer for breaking soul ties helped him. At a Catholic conference for healing, his wife uncovered and forgave abuse from childhood. The lecture ends with an invitation to those present to renew their marital vows.
